messages:
elaine: uploaded a quick prototype for the error session tile — trying to resolve a few interaction questions. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/error-session-tile
ryan: looked. overall 👍 but the correlation id feels buried when the tile is collapsed. hard to copy quickly.
maya: agree. users often need corr-id first thing for support links. can we surface a tiny copy button next to the id even in collapsed state?
elaine: that was one option. downside is visual noise. alternative is showing a short hashed id + hover reveals full with copy.
sam: preference for always-visible copy affordance (small, low-contrast). saves clicks for support flow. also: keyboard access important — tab order should reach copy before overflow menu.
aisha: accessibility note: if we keep hover-to-reveal, we need an explicit focusable control. Hover-only is not okay for keyboard/screen reader.
ryan: +1. also we should clarify copy success feedback. small toast vs transient inline text? inline text may shift layout.
maya: small inline hint that replaces the id with "Copied" for 1.5s is fine if it doesn't reflow. else toast anchored to tile.
elaine: okay, let's pick non-reflow inline microcopy. design change: copy button becomes visually subtle and swaps label to "Copied" on success. aria-live region for SRs.
ux-bot: accessibility checklist reminder: include aria-labels for the buttons, ensure focus outline, and add role="status" for the copied confirmation for SRs.
aisha: propose aria-labels: "Copy correlation id" and on success, announce "Correlation id copied to clipboard".
sam: other interaction: expand/collapse animation should be short (120ms) and not hide correlation id when tile expands — id should remain anchored top-left.
ryan: about the overflow (ellipsis) menu: current order is [Export, Open Trace, Group by]. I think export should be second, not first — users rarely export from collapsed tile.
maya: Agreed. Also export action needs confirmation modal copy: currently says "Export trace to JSON" — can we update to "Download trace (JSON) — includes full spans and logs"? clearer.
elaine: will update text. also adding small checkbox in modal: "Include request logs" default off to reduce payload confusion.
ryan: tiny CSS nit: the stacktrace preview line truncation currently uses ellipsis mid-function. Prefer to break at token boundaries and keep function name visible.
elaine: noted — update truncation to prefer showing identifier and collapse args. will add visual guideline.
sam: one more: keyboard shortcut hint on hover for "Open Trace" (e.g., ⌥O) — only if affordable.
aisha: ensure any shortcut is announced to SR users via a tooltip with aria-describedby.
elaine: thanks all — I'll push updated frames to the figma and ping again. tagging @sam for copy review once done.
sam: thanks! will do a quick pass after the push. :thumbsup:
ux-bot: linked checklist: https://internal.redwood/ux/checklists/error-tiles — remember to run a quick a11y scan before final.
